
{{alias}}( document, tokens, value )
    Immutably inserts a value into an array at a path in a document using
    structural sharing.

    Only objects and arrays along the path are shallow-cloned. All other
    subtrees keep their original references.

    The final container must be an array. The value is inserted before the
    given index, shifting existing elements right. The `-` token is resolved
    to `array.length` (append).

    Parameters
    ----------
    document: Object|Array
        Source document.

    tokens: Array<string>
        Array of reference tokens.

    value: any
        The value to insert.

    Returns
    -------
    out: Object|Array
        New document with the value inserted.

    Examples
    --------
    > var doc = { 'a': [ 1, 2, 3 ] };
    > var out = {{alias}}( doc, [ 'a', '1' ], 99 )
    { 'a': [ 1, 99, 2, 3 ] }
    > var bool = ( doc === out )
    false

    See Also
    --------
